contracts.boundary: local fail-closed controller verifies an independent receipt, exact candidate/proposed-merge evidence, GitHub checks, review state, and post-merge push evidence before recording outcome.
contracts.assertions: Controller never invokes merge when required evidence is stale, unavailable, altered, or unresolved; dry run stays non-mutating and checks preserve frozen intent.

boundaryTest.name: valid apply merges exactly once and verifies push gates

invariant.name: repeated apply preserves the frozen intent and never merges twice

fault.name: guard removal control: bypassing receipt validation reddens the named assertion, restore is green
